title: 第5章 叫破喉咙也没人救你第6章 宗门坊市
slug: 双修暴击十万次仙子倒贴求放过
content_zh:
整整一夜。
天要亮了，顾平也只是吸收了这庞大力量中的三分之一，但他的修为已经来到了炼气六层。
距离炼气七层也只有一步之遥而已。
顾平心头震撼。
这股元阴的力量，他只要顺利的完全吸收，就筑基在望了！
筑基啊，只要完成了，他的寿元就会再次增加。
不用害怕死亡了，修行成仙，不就是期待的这件事情吗？！
顾平跪坐在冰冷的泉边石上。
喉咙仍残留着萧千凝煞气侵蚀的刺痛。
他盯着她腰间晃动的玉牌“璃月仙宗九幽峰首座”
，指尖下意识地扣紧石缝。
他现在爽完之后，内心有些惴惴不安。
毕竟昨晚对她那样……
但等了片刻之后，箫千凝依旧安静打坐压制煞气，没有想要找他算账的意思。
顾平的胆子也就大了起来。
“萧长老……”
他嗓音沙哑，像锈铁摩擦，“小人斗胆……求您赏三块下品灵石。”
萧千凝睁开眼睛，眉眼斜睨过来。
她仅凭这张脸，足以封为人间绝色，顾平不敢多看。
煞气未散的泉水在她白玉足边结出细冰。

“哦？”
她尾音上挑，“一个杂役，刚碰了本座的身子，现在还敢讨赏？”
话虽然是轻佻的说出来了。
但是。
她心里却很是失望。
早就听说现在宗门里世风日下。
弟子长老所有人都对灵石尤其的势利。
虽然最后的目的都是为了得到更多灵石修行。
但这种势利、拜金的行为，她尤其的不齿。
方才她还在想这杂役老归老，但胜在体质似乎很特殊，又和她已经有了肌肤之亲，只是不知道他性情如何……想着如何处置他呢。
他反倒是抢先开口朝她索要灵石了。
这么一来，他是个什么样的人，也能窥见三份了。
而且只要了三枚下等灵石。
这样的价钱让她觉得杂役就是杂役，三枚灵石还要张口讨要。
哪怕他多要一点，她也能高看他几分。
他这样讨要，就像是和宗门内那些女修索要嫖资一样让人厌恶。
content_en:
All night long.
It was almost dawn, and Gu Ping had only absorbed one-third of this huge power, but his cultivation had reached the sixth level of Qi Refining.
It is only one step away from the seventh level of Qi Refining.
Gu Ping was shocked.
As long as he successfully and completely absorbs this Yuan Yin power, he will be able to establish his foundation!
Foundation building, as long as it is completed, his lifespan will increase again.
There is no need to be afraid of death. Isn’t it what you want to do if you practice and become an immortal? !
Gu Ping knelt down and sat on the cold stone beside the spring.
The stinging pain from Xiao Qianning's evil spirit still lingered in his throat.
He stared at the jade plaque dangling around her waist: "The First of the Nine Nether Peaks of Liyue Immortal Sect"
, fingertips subconsciously clasped the cracks in the stone.
Now that he was done enjoying himself, he felt a little uneasy inside.
After all, what he did to her last night...
But after waiting for a while, Xiao Qianning still meditated quietly to suppress the evil spirit, and had no intention of settling a score with him.
Gu Ping became more courageous.
"Elder Xiao..."
His voice was hoarse, like rusty iron rubbing against each other, "If you dare, I beg you to reward me with three low-grade spiritual stones."
Xiao Qianning opened her eyes and glanced sideways.
Her face alone was enough to be called the most beautiful woman in the world, and Gu Ping didn't dare to look at her more.
The evil spirit of the spring water has not dissipated, forming fine ice around her white jade feet.
"Oh?"
She raised her voice at the end, "A handyman just touched my body, and now he dares to ask for a reward?"
Although the words were said frivolously.
but.
She was very disappointed in her heart.
I have long heard that the current situation in the sect is declining.
All the disciples and elders are particularly snobby towards spirit stones.
Although the final goal is to get more spiritual stones to practice.
But she especially despises this kind of snobbish and money-worshipping behavior.
Just now, she was still thinking about the fact that the handyman would die in old age, but the advantage was that his physique seemed to be very special, and he already had a physical relationship with her, but she didn't know what his temperament was... and she was thinking about how to deal with him.
Instead, he was the first to ask her for the spirit stone.
In this way, we can get a glimpse of what kind of person he is.
And he only wanted three low-grade spiritual stones.
Such a price made her feel like a handyman was just a handyman, and she still had to ask for three spiritual stones.
Even if he wants a little more, she can still think highly of him.
Asking for money like this is as disgusting as asking for prostitution from the female cultivators in the sect.
